packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry modules are a version-locked family: the otel core/sdk/exporters move together and the otelslog contrib bridge trails the log minor by one. Separate PRs each fail CI because the set must move as a unit (and the bridge is never one of the flagged modules). matchSourceUrls catches both go.opentelemetry.io/* and go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/* (the bridge). Group into one PR.
go.temporal.io/* (server, api, sdk) move as a set; a server bump that outpaces its api pin breaks the build. Group so they arrive as one PR.
Automerge updates that ci.yaml actually exercises and that cannot mutate infrastructure on merge. Merging to main publishes an image via publish.yaml, which is the intended outcome.
Actions used only by publish.yaml (AWS auth, ECR push, buildx). ci.yaml's pull_request checks never invoke them, so a bad bump would surface only after merge. Review by hand.
The runtime base image is only built by publish.yaml, never on a pull request. Review by hand.
